expected.notes: §2.16 — capital equipment purchase. Warranty + repair + maintenance boilerplate at the bottom of the invoice must NOT hijack the economic purpose classifier. Actual line item is a complete new mower; the warranty text is future promise, not current work. Purpose = CAPITAL, not REPAIR.
